items.title: Coherent modules on Proj of a general Noetherian graded ring: for A Noetherian graded and X = Proj(A), the functor M -> M^tilde induces an equivalence Mod^fg_A / Mod^fg_{A,irrelevant} -> Coh(O_X) whose quasi-inverse is F |-> bigoplus_{n >= 0} Gamma(X, F(n)).

items.difficulty_reason: All four required verifications are carried out in the span: M^tilde = 0 if and only if M is irrelevant is proved using the tail recovery lemma recover-tail-graded-module-general (for one direction, fx = 0 in degrees nd > l where M_nd -> N_nd and N_nd -> N'_nd are isomorphisms; for the converse, vanishing of M_nd for n >> 0 gives M_(f_i) = M_(f_i^{d/deg f_i}) = 0); the kernel forms a Serre subcategory because M -> M^tilde is exact (Homology kernel-exact-functor, Constructions proj-sheaves), so the quotient category and the functor are defined; the quasi-inverse lands in Mod^fg_A by coherent-on-proj-general; the left-right-left composite is the identity because M -> N' and N -> N' have kernels and cokernels irrelevant (finitely many nonzero degrees / degrees divisible by d), and the right-left-right composite is the identity because M = bigoplus_{n in Z} Gamma(X, F(n)) satisfies M^tilde = F by Properties proj-quasi-coherent and M_{>= 0}^tilde -> M^tilde is an isomorphism. The author's single pointer ('read the degree-1 case first', proposition coherent-modules-on-proj) is navigation, not load-bearing.
